Former butler testifies in Alan Jones's indecent assault trial

Alan Jones, 85, is on trial facing 21 charges of indecent assault and sexual touching, including two involving a prominent athlete. His former personal butler of over 18 years, David Allan, testified in court that Jones greeted the athlete with a 'hug and slap on the bottom'. Jones has pleaded not guilty to all charges.
